items.titleZh: 铁电调谐减少LLM训练中的光互连停顿（佐治亚理工学院）
items.descriptionZh:
近几年，大语言模型（LLM）的规模急剧膨胀，尤其是混合专家（MoE）架构的兴起，使得模型参数达到万亿级别，训练时需要在数千乃至数万个加速器之间进行大量的激活和梯度交换。为了突破传统电互连在带宽、延迟和能耗上的瓶颈，晶圆级光互连技术应运而生——将光收发器件直接集成在硅晶圆上，以极高密度和超大带宽实现芯片间通信。然而，光互连器件（如微环谐振器、马赫-曾德尔调制器）的工作波长对温度极其敏感，环境变化或高功率光信号都会导致波长漂移，必须依赖热调谐（通过加热元件改变材料折射率）将器件波长对准至激光源。这一过程不仅消耗大量电力，还会造成通信阶段的“调谐停顿”——在每次数据交换前，系统必须暂时中止数据传输，等待热调谐完成，从而严重拖慢MoE训练的整体速度。

针对这一问题，佐治亚理工学院的研究团队发表了一篇题为《Thermal Tuning Overhead in Wafer-Scale Optical Interconnects for LLM MoE Training: A Cross-Layer Analysis and Ferroelectric-Based Mitigation》的技术论文。论文首先对晶圆级光互连在MoE训练场景下的热调谐开销进行了跨层分析——从底层器件物理特性、电路设计，到上层通信模式与训练调度策略，全面揭示了反复出现的调谐停顿是如何在通信阶段累积成巨大性能损失的。作者指出，在MoE训练中，通信是频繁且突发性的，每个token都要经过路由器动态选择专家，导致通信模式高度不规则，这进一步放大了热调谐带来的同步开销。

论文的核心创新点在于引入铁电材料来替代传统纯热调谐机制。铁电材料具有非易失的自发极化特性，其极化状态可通过外加电场翻转并稳定保持，从而快速改变材料的折射率或光波导的有效介电常数。基于这一原理，研究者设计了一种铁电辅助的光调谐器件：在极低功耗下通过电压脉冲实现波长快速校准，且不需要持续加热维持状态，从根本上消除了热惯性带来的等待时间。相比传统热调谐器（毫秒级响应、持续功耗），铁电调谐器具有纳秒或微秒级响应速度、近乎零的静态功耗，并能在断电后保持调谐状态，非常适合高频次、短时间的通信间隙。论文将此技术应用于晶圆级光互连系统，并与跨层设计的电路控制策略结合，使得通信阶段的调谐停顿大幅减少。

性能方面，论文报告了显著的加速效果：在MoE大模型训练典型工作负载下，所提出的铁电调谐方案实现了最高2.7倍的训练速度提升。这一提升并非来自单纯某一层的改进，而是通过跨层联合优化——在器件层面用铁电调谐降低延迟，在电路层面设计高效的电压驱动与状态切换机制，在系统层面调整通信调度以充分利用快速调谐的特性——才最终获得的。虽然2.7倍是一个聚合指标，但论文还强调了它意味着在通信密集的专家并行（EP）配置中，原本占训练总时间近一半的通信等待时间被大幅压缩，从而使GPU/加速器的计算资源得到更充分的利用。

该研究对大规模AI训练基础设施的设计具有重要指导意义。随着MoE模型成为主流，晶圆级光互连是下一代AI超级计算机的关键技术之一，而热调谐开销很可能成为其规模化部署的“暗礁”。该项工作首次系统地量化了这一开销，并提出基于铁电材料的集成解决方案，为开发低功耗、快速响应、高可靠的光互连提供了一条可行路径。除了LLM训练，该技术还可用于多模态大模型训练、大规模推理集群，以及未来的光学算力互联、光交换数据中心等场景——凡是需要高带宽、低延迟、低成本光通信的地方，都可能从铁电调谐技术中受益。当然，论文中的方案仍面临硅基铁电材料（如HfZrOx）的集成工艺成熟度、规模化良率等挑战，但这一研究方向无疑为超大规模AI算力集群性价比提升打开了新的空间。

items.titleZh: 生成式设计优化2.5D和3D封装的液冷通道（密歇根大学迪尔伯恩分校）
items.descriptionZh:
随着人工智能、高性能计算和先进制程的持续演进，2.5D与3D集成封装已成为突破芯片性能瓶颈的关键技术路线。然而，多芯片堆叠和高功率密度带来的严峻热挑战，正成为系统可靠性与性能发挥的核心制约因素。针对这一问题，密歇根大学迪尔伯恩分校（University of Michigan-Dearborn）的研究人员发表了一篇题为《Generative Design of Liquid-Cooling Channels for Thermal Management of 2.5D and 3D Integrated Advanced Packaging》的技术论文，提出了一种基于物理引导的生成式设计框架，用于液冷通道的拓扑优化，从而实现更高效的散热方案。

该研究聚焦于一个功率高达2.7千瓦的多芯片封装系统，其中包含两颗高功率GPU和一颗CPU。在如此高的总功耗下，传统风冷或简单液冷方案难以有效控制热点温度，尤其是在2.5D/3D封装中，芯片间通过硅中介层或垂直堆叠方式互联，热耦合效应显著，热量传递路径复杂。论文提出的生成式设计方法并非依赖传统经验式通道布局，而是将流体力学、传热学等物理规律嵌入生成式算法中，在给定封装结构、热源分布和冷却液约束条件下，自动搜索并优化液冷通道的拓扑形态，使冷却液分布更贴合实际热负荷需求，从而最大化散热效率并降低泵功耗。

该框架的核心创新点在于“物理引导”与“生成式”的结合。传统拓扑优化通常需要大量人工设定初始结构，计算成本高且容易陷入局部最优；而生成式设计能够通过算法自动探索广阔的通道几何空间，产生非直觉但性能优异的流道构型。同时，物理引导机制确保了生成结果在真实热流耦合场景下的可行性，兼顾流动阻力、温度均匀性和结构可制造性。研究进一步探讨了该设计方法在2.5D与3D封装中的差异适应能力，并验证了多芯片协同冷却的可行性。

在性能与对比层面，该研究展示了优化后的液冷通道相比常规设计在温度控制、系统热阻以及冷却液流动功耗方面的显著改善。尽管具体数值需要查阅论文全文，但研究表明，生成式液冷通道能够更精确地将冷却液引导至芯片热点区域，有效降低峰值结温，提升封装的整体可靠性，并可能减少对高成本热界面材料或复杂微通道制造工艺的依赖。

这一技术的影响与应用场景十分广泛。对于AI加速卡、高性能服务器、数据中心和边缘计算设备而言，2.5D/3D封装常被用于集成GPU、CPU、HBM等高功耗器件，液冷通道的智能化设计可直接提升这些系统的散热上限，为下一代算力基础设施提供有力的热管理保障。此外，该框架也可拓展至其他功率电子、激光器、电动汽车逆变器等需要液冷散热的场景，推动生成式设计与热力系统协同优化的工程实践。总体而言，这项研究为先进封装热管理提供了一条从“经验设计”走向“智能生成”的可行路径，有助于释放高密度集成芯片的潜在性能，同时降低冷却系统的能耗与制造成本。

items.content: Just as new data centers face growing backlash from neighboring communities, the US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) is about to make it harder for people to weigh in on any pollution those centers create.The EPA plans to toss out a federal rule requiring public notice and an opportunity to comment when certain industrial sites apply for an air permit. Advocates warn that the move would allow data center developers and other industries to break ground without giving nearby residents a say, or even a warning that construction is planned.“You can see why that would be so interesting to an administration that wants to rush through the construction of data centers,” says Keri Powell, senior attorney and air program leader at the Southern Environmental Law Center (SELC). “What EPA would be allowing would be all of those facilities to go through and just not have to deal with the public, issue the permits in secret behind closed doors. Nobody knows what’s happening until the bulldozers are out there.”“Nobody knows what’s happening until the bulldozers are out there.”The EPA’s proposed changes apply to a permitting process that’s been in place since the 1970s called New Source Review that applies to a wide range of facilities, from landfills and paper mills to power plant expansions. More recently with the rise of generative AI, these permits have also become a flashpoint for opposition to new data centers, as well as to power plants built to provide electricity for all those servers.In July, the EPA announced that it would eliminate the federal public participation requirement for a large set of polluters and place that burden on states. The plan would leave it up to state and local air agencies to decide whether or not to notify the public about certain new sources of pollution — leaving advocates concerned that many of these agencies would forgo the process altogether. Air pollution is often regulated at the federal level because it can waft across the country, affecting residents in one state even if the source is in another.“The state and local authorities closest to the issues and the public should be making the decisions on the permitting process as much as possible, not Washington,” EPA administrator Lee Zeldin said in a statement at the time. “We are cutting unnecessary and burdensome red tape.”The change applies to so-called “minor” sources of pollution, which the EPA says in its announcement “have relatively low emissions and limited environmental impact.” Powell’s group contends that the “minor” label is a misnomer and that the permitting process routinely covers projects that can have significant consequences for their neighbors.Colossus 1, xAI’s massive data center in Tennessee that the company billed as the “most powerful AI training system yet,” applied for a minor source permit in 2025. That led to a hearing and elicited thousands of comments to a public notice posted by the local health department, Inside Climate News reported last year. The SELC and NAACP threatened to sue xAI for installing unpermitted gas turbines at the site the same year.SELC was one of nearly 200 health and environmental groups that filed comments last Friday asking the EPA to withdraw its proposal on New Source Review. They argue that by mandating public comment, residents can provide agencies with valuable insight on the repercussions of building a new data center or other industrial facility.“[The EPA’s proposal] could deprive the agencies making decisions about these [pollution] sources the necessary lived experience data of those communities. Without that information, it is impossible for permitting agencies to evaluate the full, cumulative impact of these facilities,” Kentucky Resources Council Senior Attorney Byron Gary said in a press release.The public comment period for the EPA’s proposal ended last week, and EPA spokesperson Carolyn Holran says in an email to The Verge that they’re still reviewing all the comments submitted — more than 4,900 that need to be addressed before the agency can finalize its rule.

items.titleZh: Trump’s EPA wants to let data centers hide their air pollution
items.descriptionZh:
在美国各地数据中心建设日益引发周边社区强烈反对之际，美国环保署（EPA）却正打算削弱公众对这些项目污染问题的发言权。该机构计划废除一项自1970年代以来实施的联邦规定——即“新源审查”（New Source Review）程序中，要求特定工业设施在申请空气许可时必须进行公开通知并提供公众评议机会。这一变动意味着，数据中心开发商及其他工业项目将能在不通知附近居民、甚至不让他们知晓施工计划的情况下直接破土动工。

“你能理解为什么这对一个急于推进数据中心建设速度的政府来说如此有吸引力，”南方环境法律中心（SELC）高级律师兼空气项目负责人凯里·鲍威尔表示，“环保署的做法是让所有这些设施绕过公众，闭门秘密发放许可。直到推土机开到家门口，没有人知道发生了什么。”

新源审查制度适用于从垃圾填埋场、造纸厂到发电厂扩建等一系列广泛设施。近年来，随着生成式人工智能的爆发式增长，这类许可也成为公众反对新建数据中心及其配套供电电厂的关键焦点。

今年7月，环保署宣布将取消对一大批污染源的联邦公众参与要求，并将这一责任转移给各州。该计划将决定权交由州和地方空气管理机构，由它们自行决定是否就某些新污染源通知公众——倡导者担忧，许多机构可能会完全放弃这一程序。由于空气污染往往具有跨州传播的特性——一个州的污染源可能影响另一个州的居民——联邦层面的监管历来被视为必要的保障。

环保署署长李·泽尔丁当时在声明中表示：“最贴近问题和公众的州和地方机构应尽可能多地决定许可程序，而不是由华盛顿来拍板。我们正在削减不必要的繁琐程序。”

这一变动适用于所谓的“次要”污染源，环保署在公告中称其“排放量相对较低，环境影响有限”。但南方环境法律中心认为，“次要”这一标签具有误导性，许可程序所覆盖的项目常常对周边居民产生重大影响。

以xAI位于田纳西州的巨型数据中心“Colossus 1”为例，该公司称其为“迄今最强大的AI训练系统”。该项目于2025年申请了次要源许可，据《内部气候新闻》报道，该申请引发了听证会，当地卫生部门发布的公告收到了数千条公众意见。同年，南方环境法律中心和全国有色人种协进会（NAACP）威胁起诉xAI，因其在未获许可的情况下安装了燃气轮机。

南方环境法律中心是上周五提交意见、要求环保署撤回新源审查提案的近200个健康与环境组织之一。他们认为，强制公众评议能够让居民为监管机构提供关于新建数据中心或其他工业设施影响的宝贵实地认知。

肯塔基州资源委员会高级律师拜伦·加里在新闻稿中指出：“环保署的提案可能剥夺决策机构获取这些社区真实生活经验数据的机会。没有这些信息，许可机构不可能评估这些设施的完整累积影响。”

环保署提案的公众评议期已于上周结束。该机构发言人卡罗琳·霍兰在给The Verge的邮件中表示，他们仍在审阅收到的超过4900条意见，这些意见需要在规则最终定稿前全部处理完毕。

items.title: MSI brings DDR4 back to gaming laptops amidst DRAM crisis — Katana 15 HX C14 available with up to Core i9-14900HX and RTX 5070
items.description: With 32GB DDR4 SO-DIMM memory kits costing roughly half as much as comparable DDR5 kits, MSI’s new Katana 15 HX C14 could help reduce the impact of soaring memory prices.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 5 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The ongoing DRAM crisis has led to a sharp increase in laptop prices, with manufacturers facing exponentially high component costs, particularly memory and SSDs. The situation has created a growing gap in the affordable gaming laptop segment, with most entry-level models becoming increasingly expensive. In its response, MSI has introduced the new Katana 15 HX C14 that features Intel’s 14th-gen Raptor Lake Refresh processors along with support for both DDR5 and DDR4-3200 memory.Depending on the region, MSI will be offering the value-focused gaming laptop in two variants, featuring dual SO-DIMM slots with either DDR4 or DDR5 compatibility. For context, a 32GB (2x16GB) DDR4-3200 SO-DIMM memory kit can be purchased for around $200, while a DDR5-6000 kit goes for over $400. MSI did not specify the DDR4 capacity as standard, only that the laptop supports up to 96GB, which seems unlikely given no 48GB DDR4 SO-DIMMs exist.Configurable with up to a 24-core Intel Core i9-14900HX processor, the laptop should offer plenty of CPU performance for demanding tasks besides gaming. It will be available with up to an Nvidia RTX 5070 laptop GPU offering support for the latest AI features, GDDR7 memory, DLSS 4.5, and real-time ray tracing. MSI claims that the Katana 15 HX C14 is tuned for up to 170W of combined CPU and GPU power, while the cooling system with dual fans, three heat pipes, and four exhaust outlets helps in sustained performance. There are also dual-PCIe Gen 4x4 M.2 slots, allowing gamers to add a separate SSD dedicated to their gaming library.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Display options include a 15.6-inch IPS panel available with either QHD (2560x1440) resolution that supports up to a 165 Hz refresh rate or FHD (1920x1080) resolution with up to a 144 Hz refresh rate. In terms of design, the laptop comes in a stealthy black finish with textured slash patterns inspired by traditional Japanese blades along with bright red logos. The chassis measures 22.9mm in terms of thickness and weighs 4.62 pounds, making it fairly compact for a 15-inch gaming notebook.Other notable features include support for Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.4, a 4-Zone RGB gaming keyboard with 1.7mm key travel, a 240W power adapter, USB Type-C with Power Delivery 3.0, a 60Whr battery, and DTS-enhanced dual 2W speakers. According to MSI, the new Katana 15 HX C14 will be available globally, although there's no pricing information at the moment. items.titleZh: MSI brings DDR4 back to gaming laptops amidst DRAM crisis — Katana 15 HX C14 available with up to Core i9-14900HX and RTX 5070
items.descriptionZh:
持续的DRAM（动态随机存取存储器）供应危机正深刻影响着PC市场，内存与固态硬盘（SSD）等核心组件成本暴涨，直接导致笔记本价格全线攀升，尤其是原本性价比突出的入门级游戏本市场，如今已出现明显的价格断层。为应对这一困境，MSI（微星）推出了新款Katana 15 HX C14游戏笔记本电脑，其最大特点是灵活支持DDR4和DDR5两种内存标准，让用户可以根据预算和需求自主选择，从而在内存价格高企的当下提供更具性价比的解决方案。

这款笔记本的核心创新在于其“双内存策略”。根据不同销售区域，MSI将提供两个版本，均配备双SO-DIMM插槽，但分别兼容DDR4-3200或DDR5内存。这一设计在主流游戏本中相当罕见，因为绝大多数机型已完全转向DDR5。其背后的逻辑源于巨大的价格差异：目前一套32GB（2×16GB）的DDR4-3200 SO-DIMM内存套件售价约为200美元，而同等容量的DDR5-6000套件则超过400美元，两者价差高达一倍以上。在DRAM危机导致内存价格飙升的背景下，允许用户选择DDR4无疑能显著降低整机成本，尤其对预算敏感的入门级玩家极具吸引力。不过，MSI并未明确DDR4版本的标配容量，仅表示支持最高96GB内存——考虑到目前并不存在48GB容量的DDR4 SO-DIMM条，这一上限在DDR4平台上似乎不太实际，可能更多是理论规格。

在核心硬件配置上，Katana 15 HX C14搭载了英特尔第14代酷睿处理器（Raptor Lake Refresh架构），最高可选24核的酷睿i9-14900HX，拥有强大的多线程性能，足以应对游戏之外的视频渲染、3D建模等重负载任务。图形方面，笔记本最高配备Nvidia RTX 5070笔记本电脑GPU，基于新一代架构，支持最新的AI加速特性、GDDR7显存、DLSS 4.5超分辨率技术以及实时光线追踪，可带来更流畅的光影效果和AI辅助性能提升。值得一提的是，MSI宣称该机在CPU与GPU协同工作时的总功耗可调校至170瓦，为了在如此高的功耗下维持稳定性能，散热系统采用了双风扇、三根热管和四个出风口的组合设计，确保长时间高负载运行时不会出现过热降频。存储扩展方面，机器提供两个PCIe Gen 4x4 M.2插槽，玩家可额外加装一块固态硬盘专门存放游戏库，满足日益庞大的游戏体积需求。

屏幕与外观方面，Katana 15 HX C14配备一块15.6英寸IPS面板，提供两种规格可选：QHD（2560×1440）分辨率支持最高165Hz刷新率，或FHD（1920×1080）分辨率支持最高144Hz刷新率，兼顾细腻画质与流畅电竞体验。外观设计上，笔记本采用哑光黑色机身，饰有灵感源自传统日本武士刀的斜纹纹理，搭配亮红色MSI龙盾logo，风格内敛而富有攻击性。整机厚度22.9毫米，重量约4.62磅（约2.1公斤），对于一款15英寸游戏本而言相对紧凑便携。

其他实用功能还包括：支持Wi-Fi 6E和蓝牙5.4无线连接；配备四分区RGB背光游戏键盘，键程为1.7毫米，打字和游戏手感舒适；附带240W电源适配器；提供支持Power Delivery 3.0的USB Type-C接口，方便外接设备快充；内置60瓦时电池；音频方面由DTS增强的双2W扬声器输出环绕声效。据MSI称，Katana 15 HX C14将面向全球市场发售，但截至目前尚未公布具体定价。

从更宏观的角度看，这款产品的推出反映了PC厂商在内存价格危机下的务实应对策略。通过同时支持DDR4与DDR5，MSI既满足了追求极致性能、愿意为DDR5买单的玩家，又照顾了预算有限、希望以较低成本升级内存的入门级用户。在DRAM价格持续高企的时期，这种“新旧兼容”的做法为游戏本市场提供了一条中间路径，有望缓解部分消费者因存储成本上涨而推迟换机的焦虑。对于普通用户而言，选择DDR4版本可以立即节省一笔可观的升级费用，而DDR5版本则为未来向高性能内存过渡保留了空间。这种灵活配置能否成为行业应对芯片价格波动的通用方案，值得后续观察。

items.title: Nvidia gears up its influence in Washington, forming PAC — tells employees that decisions Congress makes over the coming years could have substantial consequences for the AI industry, according to report
items.description: Nvidia establishes its employees federal political action committee (PAC) to fund politicians whose positions are favorable to Nvidia's interests.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 8 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter When you serve a barely regulated emerging market worth trillions of dollars, you have to gear up your presence in politics beyond what usual lobbying or government affairs can do. This is exactly what Nvidia is doing by establishing its employees' federal political action committee (PAC), which will fund politicians whose positions are favorable to Nvidia's interests, reports Bloomberg.Go deeper with TH Premium: Taiwan, trade, and tariffs (Image credit: tsmc)While the U.S. flip-flops on chip sanctions, China is building its own chip supply marketThe state of China's decade-long semiconductor pushHuawei Ascend NPU roadmap examined China's CXMT targets 30% DRAM memory market share by 2030 with sixth mega-fabChina's latest round of rare-earth export controls explainedThe Nvidia employees PAC — which was registered with the Federal Election Commission on Thursday — will receive voluntary contributions from eligible Nvidia employees, who can provide up to $5,000 per year. The PAC will be permitted to contribute to federal candidates from both parties as well as party committees that express positions which align well with Nvidia's own goals, particularly in the fields of AI regulations, export controls, education, infrastructure spending, and workforce policy, just to name a few.Nvidia reportedly told employees eligible to participate that decisions Congress makes over the coming years could have substantial consequences for the AI industry and everyday use of the technology. The company also noted that policymakers have increasingly focused on its industry and that decisions made in Washington affect both Nvidia's business and its customers' ability to obtain and deploy its technologies.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Nvidia has already substantially expanded its political operation. The company has spent more than $2.5 million on federal lobbying this year, an increase compared with the same period last year, according to lobbying disclosures seen by Bloomberg. In June, Nvidia hired Bruce Andrews, who previously headed government affairs at Intel and served as deputy secretary at the U.S. Commerce Department in Obama's government, as chief external affairs officer. In addition, Nvidia has hired five external Washington lobbying and government-relations firms to advocate for the company on a range of issues, including AI and trade policy, among others. The company also donated $1 million to the Trump Vance Inaugural Committee in January 2025.Nvidia needs a PAC because lobbying and campaign contributions serve different purposes. The company can spend corporate money to lobby lawmakers, but it generally cannot use corporate treasury funds to contribute directly to federal candidates. Meanwhile, a company-sponsored PAC has a legal mechanism to collect voluntary contributions from eligible employees and direct that money to candidates and party committees from either party. You may like Chinese military has been acquiring Nvidia chips, even post-Washington export controls, research claims Nvidia slashes list of authorized customers in Asia in a bid to reduce AI chip smuggling, report claims Nvidia employee implicated in escalating AI GPU smuggling scandal Meanwhile, unlike individual campaign contributions, donations made by the PAC will be publicly disclosed and subject to spending limits that do not increase with inflation. Furthermore, corporate PACs face growing resistance from lawmakers, according to Bloomberg. More than 270 House and Senate candidates have pledged to reject corporate PAC contributions this election cycle, the highest number since End Citizens United began promoting the commitment in 2018, Bloomberg claims. However, it is unclear whether these 270 are serious major-party nominees or current members of Congress, or some of the thousands of declared congressional candidates.Nvidia is hardly alone in increasing spending on its influence in Washington, as most high-tech companies, now joined by AI giants, tend to spend millions on government relations and lobbying. items.titleZh: Nvidia gears up its influence in Washington, forming PAC — tells employees that decisions Congress makes over the coming years could have substantial consequences for the AI industry, according to report
items.descriptionZh:
在人工智能芯片市场价值高达数万亿美元、且监管尚不成熟的背景下，英伟达（Nvidia）正采取一项超越传统游说或政府事务范畴的政治布局：据彭博社报道，该公司已为其员工设立联邦政治行动委员会（PAC），以资助那些对英伟达利益持友好立场的政治候选人。

该PAC于周四在联邦选举委员会（FEC）注册，接受符合条件的英伟达员工的自愿捐款，每位员工每年最高可捐5000美元。PAC将能够向两党联邦候选人以及支持英伟达目标（特别是在人工智能监管、出口管制、教育、基础设施支出和劳动力政策等领域）的政党委员会提供捐款。英伟达告知符合资格的员工，美国国会在未来几年做出的决策可能对人工智能行业及其日常应用产生重大影响。公司还指出，政策制定者越来越关注该行业，华盛顿的决定既影响英伟达的业务，也影响其客户获取和部署其技术的能力。

英伟达已大幅扩展其政治运作。根据彭博社看到的游说披露文件，该公司今年在联邦游说上的支出已超过250万美元，高于去年同期的水平。今年6月，英伟达聘请了布鲁斯·安德鲁斯（Bruce Andrews）担任首席对外事务官，他曾负责英特尔政府事务，并在奥巴马政府中担任美国商务部副部长。此外，英伟达还聘请了五家外部华盛顿游说和政府关系公司，就人工智能和贸易政策等一系列问题为其辩护。该公司还在2025年1月向特朗普-万斯就职委员会捐赠了100万美元。

英伟达需要PAC，因为游说和竞选捐款的功能不同。公司可以动用企业资金游说立法者，但通常不能直接使用公司资金向联邦候选人捐款。而公司赞助的PAC提供了一个合法机制，可以收集合格员工的自愿捐款，并将资金导向两党候选人和政党委员会。与个人竞选捐款不同，PAC的捐款将公开披露，并受支出限制，且限制额度不随通胀调整。此外，彭博社指出，企业PAC正面临越来越多的立法者抵制。自2018年End Citizens United组织发起拒绝企业PAC捐款的承诺以来，当前选举周期中已有超过270名众议院和参议院候选人承诺拒绝此类捐款，创下历史新高。

英伟达并非唯一增加在华盛顿影响力支出的公司，大多数高科技企业以及新加入的人工智能巨头每年都会花费数百万美元用于政府关系和游说。设立PAC只是凸显了英伟达对华盛顿政策日益加深的依赖。

items.title: DLSS 5 has already been ported to work on RTX 4000 Series graphics cards — incompatible CUDA instructions get patched to work on previous-gen hardware
items.description: One modder has reverse-engineered DLSS 5 to function on RTX 4000 series Ada Lovelace-based GPUs, porting incompatible CUDA instructions within the Neural Rendering DLL, enabling them to be read on previous-gen hardware.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 3 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Tom's Hardware has verified that modders have managed to get DLSS 5 up and running on RTX 4000 series graphics cards, following the leaked release of the DLSS 5 nvngx_dlssnr.dll yesterday, which saw modders flock to integrate it into other titles outside of Remedy Entertainment's Control.Yesterday, modders managed to get Nvidia's DLSS 5 running inside Control, and now in other titles. The early access version of NBA 2K27 contained a new file enabling the Neural Rendering technique, and has since been ported to other games.The RenoDX Discord server has been the center of action for all of the development of getting this early version of Neural Rendering to function on other pieces of software. The modification leverages both ReShade and RenoDX to essentially activate the additional files.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Nvidia Dlss 5 NR Ada Lovelace patch - YouTube Watch On While it's clearly an early look at the technology, one limitation of the current binary available has been that it only works with RTX 5000 Series Blackwell GPUs. This is even though the AI model contained within the DLL runs on FP8, which can be read and executed on previous-gen Ada Lovelace hardware. The reason behind the incompatibility (as TechPowerUp explained) is that certain CUDA binaries can only be read by Blackwell GPUs.However, intrepid RTX Remix modder "Uncle Burrito" has since patched the DLL file to get things working on Ada Lovelace hardware. "All I had to do was look into it to see what binaries it's actually using. Find the ones that aren't compatible with Ada, and then patch in fresh ones myself," the modder told Tom's Hardware. They continued to share that, since the nvngx_dlssnr.dll for NBA 2K27 was likely an early development build, Ada-equivalent binaries had likely not been built for it. You may like Modders get leaked DLSS 5 running in Control Nvidia's DLSS 5 can switch between three AI models in real-time with different levels of detail Open-source Vulkan driver NVK gains experimental DLSS support Tom's Hardware has verified that Uncle Burrito's patch works when using an Nvidia RTX 4080, and that multiple versions of such a patch are in the works from other developers within the RenoDX Discord server.Currently, official DLSS 5 support on non-Blackwell hardware remains a question mark, though after seeing the work that modders have done to get things up and running on previous-generation hardware, Nvidia may choose to release it for previous-generation GPUs. items.titleZh: DLSS 5 has already been ported to work on RTX 4000 Series graphics cards — incompatible CUDA instructions get patched to work on previous-gen hardware
items.descriptionZh:
昨日Nvidia DLSS 5的nvngx_dlssnr.dll文件泄露后，游戏改装圈迅速掀起了一波技术探索热潮。最初，改装者成功让DLSS 5在《控制》（Control）中运行，随后这一突破又扩展到了其他游戏。据悉，在《NBA 2K27》的提前体验版本中包含了一个启用神经渲染（Neural Rendering）技术的新文件，该文件现已被成功移植到多款其他作品中。

围绕这一进展的核心技术挑战在于兼容性问题。尽管DLSS 5 DLL中内置的AI模型运行在FP8精度上，理论上英伟达上一代Ada Lovelace架构硬件（即RTX 40系列）完全能够读取和执行，但实际运行却受阻。原因是该DLL中包含的某些CUDA二进制文件被编译为仅限Blackwell架构GPU（即RTX 50系列）识别，这在初始阶段将RTX 40系列用户挡在了门外。

打破这一限制的关键人物是RTX Remix改装者"Uncle Burrito"。他采取的方式是深入分析DLL内部实际调用的二进制文件，定位那些与Ada架构不兼容的部分，然后亲手替换为兼容的新二进制。"我需要做的就是查看它实际使用的是哪些二进制文件，找出与Ada不兼容的部分，然后自己打上新的补丁，"他如此向Tom's Hardware解释。他还指出，《NBA 2K27》所使用的nvngx_dlssnr.dll很可能是早期开发版本，当时并未同步构建Ada等效的二进制文件，这为后续的补丁带来了可能。

Tom's Hardware经过实际验证确认，Uncle Burrito的补丁能够在搭载RTX 4080的系统中正常运行，并且目前RenoDX Discord服务器上的其他开发者也在开发多种不同版本的补丁方案。目前，Nvidia官方是否会将DLSS 5支持扩展到非Blackwell硬件仍是个未知数，但看到改装社区的这些成果后，Nvidia或许有理由为上一代GPU提供官方支持。不过，若要支持Ampere（RTX 30系列）及更早的硬件，将面临巨大挑战，因为这些架构没有原生的FP8支持能力。

从技术脉络来看，DLSS 5的神经渲染代表了AI图形渲染的前沿方向，能够实现更精细的细节表现和更高效的渲染性能。RenoDX Discord服务器在这场技术扩散中扮演了核心枢纽的角色，改装者们利用ReShade和RenoDX这两个工具组合激活了额外的文件，从而让这一前沿技术跨越硬件代际的藩篱。从实际影响来看，这一突破对于广大RTX 40系列用户意义重大，意味着他们可能在官方路径之外率先体验到新一代AI渲染技术的能力，同时也为整个图形技术社区提供了宝贵的技术验证样本。

items.title: Nvidia denies pausing AI cloud commitments initiative after reported partner backlash — report claims company told cloud providers it could only lease its GPUs to Nvidia-approved customers
items.description: Nvidia denies putting AI cloud commitments initiative on hold despite reports that some deals were paused amid partner pushback over customer controls and concerns about potential antitrust scrutiny.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Nvidia on Friday denied a report by the Wall Street Journal claiming that the company had put some transactions under its recently introduced 'take or pay' AI Compute Partnership on hold, less than two months after unveiling the initiative in early July and days before detailing the effort in its earnings call. The transactions were reportedly paused as some partners were irritated with Nvidia's attempts to influence their operations and because it raised internal concerns about potential antitrust scrutiny.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsible"The new business model we introduced in July that opens up compute access to the fast-growing AI ecosystem is still in place and continues to evolve due to high demand," a spokesperson for Nvidia told Tom's Hardware.The report itself does not establish that Nvidia has abandoned the AI Compute Partnership program under which the company committed to rent capacity of newly built AI data centers as well as their minimum revenue, but claims that it put some deals on hold. Meanwhile, Nvidia's denial indicates that the program continues to exist, but is evolving, which means changing.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Per the report, it looks like Nvidia attempted to control how its 'AI Compute Partners' rented their capacity. The company told some cloud providers participating in the program that they could lease its GPUs only to customers approved by Nvidia, according to the WSJ report. The company also preferred to spread available capacity across multiple smaller AI companies instead of allowing a single large customer to take most or all of it. Some cloud operators reportedly pushed back against these restrictions, arguing that they should retain control over which customers they serve. Perhaps, in turn, Nvidia put some of the deals on hold.While Nvidia does not lend any money or directly finance AI data center buildouts (which essentially means circular financing), it provides demand commitments and guaranteed revenue levels, which perhaps raised internal concerns about potential antitrust scrutiny. As a result, Nvidia could be revising the terms of the deals it inks with partners. You may like Nvidia revenue tops $96 billion as memory commitments soar to $160 billion Nvidia offers to take a cut of AI cloud revenue on top of hardware sales in new optional financing vehicle Nvidia teams up with financial giants to create $500 billion AI infrastructure funds $36 billion of commitmentsModern AI data centers cost billions of dollars that must be spent on the premises, infrastructure, and compute hardware well before an operator has secured enough customer contracts to finance the buildout. Meanwhile, banks or infrastructure investors want confidence that enough of the future facility capacity will actually be rented. Under the program, Nvidia intends to use its own demand commitment on a portion of the facility's capacity in exchange for a percentage of the facility's revenue if demand is strong. This makes financing AI data centers easier as from the lender's perspective, part of the project's revenue stream is effectively supported by Nvidia rather than depending entirely on the operator's ability to find customers."Nvidia provides a take-or-pay commitment on a portion of the facility's capacity, a minimum revenue guarantee that gives lenders the confidence to underwrite the project, and in exchange, we share in a portion of the NeoCloud's revenue earned above that floor," explained Colette Kress, chief financial officer of Nvidia, during the company's earnings call. "In this model, we get paid twice, once on the hardware sale, and again through the share of rental revenue, a highly recurring stream layered on top of a one-time equipment purchase."Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsWhile actual percentages and economic terms have not been disclosed, it should work pretty straightforwardly. Nvidia provides a take-or-pay commitment that it rents, say, 30% of the capacity of a newly built facility and a minimum revenue guarantee over a period of six years. If the demand is strong and the facility rents 80% of its capacity, well exceeding the minimum revenue guarantee, Nvidia does not need to absorb the guaranteed capacity, and because revenue exceeds the agreed floor, Nvidia receives a percentage of the excess revenue. If the demand is weak and the facility can only rent 20% of its capacity, running well below the guaranteed revenue level, Nvidia's take-or-pay obligation would require it to cover the difference between actual revenue and the contracted minimum according to the specific agreement. Alternatively, Nvidia could rent back unused compute capacity for its own needs and cover the difference between the actual and guaranteed revenue level.While at least some participants were reportedly irritated with Nvidia's alleged control of tenants, the program has proven to be quite a success so far. As of late July, just weeks after formally announcing the program, Nvidia had committed $36 billion in these new agreements that run for six years."Our commitments, which are typically six years in duration, totaled $36 billion as of July 26, 2026," an Nvidia filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission reads.Nvidia has not disclosed which portions of monetizable capacities it typically commits, so it is impossible to figure out the value of the hardware it intends to supply under the $36 billion commitments. 英伟达于周五否认了《华尔街日报》的一篇报道，该报道声称公司已暂停了其新推出的“照付不议”（take-or-pay）AI计算合作伙伴计划下的部分交易。这项计划于7月初正式启动，不到两个月后便遭遇上述质疑，而英伟达原定在随后的财报电话会议上详细阐述该计划。据《华尔街日报》报道，部分交易被暂停的原因，一方面是一些合作伙伴对英伟达试图干预其运营感到不满，另一方面则是公司内部对潜在反垄断审查的担忧。英伟达发言人在回应Tom's Hardware时表示：“我们在7月推出的、为快速增长的AI生态系统开放算力接入的新商业模式仍然有效，并因高需求而持续演进。”该报道本身并未证明英伟达已放弃这一计划——该计划下英伟达承诺租用新建AI数据中心的部分容量并保证其最低收入——而只是声称部分交易被搁置。英伟达的否认则表明计划仍在，但正在“演进”，即意味着调整。

根据报道，英伟达试图控制其“AI计算合作伙伴”如何出租容量。英伟达告知参与该计划的一些云服务提供商，它们只能将英伟达GPU租赁给英伟达批准的客户。同时，英伟达倾向于将可用容量分散到多个较小的AI公司，而非让单个大客户占用大部分或全部资源。部分云运营商对这类限制表示抵制，认为它们应保留选择服务客户的自主权。或许正因如此，英伟达暂停了部分交易。

虽然英伟达并不直接出借资金或为AI数据中心建设提供直接融资（这本质上避免了循环融资），但它提供需求承诺和最低收入保证，这或许引发了内部对反垄断审查的担忧。因此，英伟达可能正在修订与合作伙伴签署的交易条款。现代AI数据中心的建设成本高达数十亿美元，且必须在运营商获得足够客户合同来支撑建设之前，就投入场地、基础设施和算力硬件。同时，银行或基础设施投资者希望确信未来设施中有足够多的容量能够实际被租用。在该计划下，英伟达利用自身对设施部分容量的需求承诺，换取当需求强劲时该设施一定比例的收入分成。这使得AI数据中心更容易获得融资，因为从贷款方的角度看，项目部分收入流实际上由英伟达背书，而非完全依赖运营商自行寻找客户的能力。

英伟达首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯在财报电话会议上解释道：“英伟达对设施部分容量提供照付不议承诺，即最低收入保证，这给了贷款方承销项目的信心，作为交换，我们分享NeoCloud超过该收入下限部分的一定比例收入。在这种模式下，我们获得两次收入：一次是硬件销售，另一次是租金收入分成——这是在一次性设备购买之上叠加的高经常性收入流。”虽然具体比例和经济条款未披露，但其运作机制基本清晰：例如，英伟达承诺租用新建设施30%的容量，并给予六年期的最低收入保证。如果需求强劲，设施租出80%容量，远超最低收入保证，那么英伟达无需吸收保证的容量，且因收入超过约定下限，英伟达将获得超额收入的一定比例。如果需求疲软，设施仅租出20%容量，远低于保证收入水平，则英伟达的照付不议义务将要求其根据具体协议弥补实际收入与合同最低收入之间的差额。或者，英伟达可以租回未使用的算力供自身使用，并弥补实际收入与保证收入之间的差额。

尽管据报道至少部分参与者对英伟达涉嫌控制租户感到不满，但该计划迄今已相当成功。截至7月底，即正式宣布计划仅数周后，英伟达已承诺在这些为期六年的协议中投入360亿美元。英伟达提交给美国证券交易委员会的文件显示：“我们的承诺期限通常为六年，截至2026年7月26日（注：原文如此，疑为2025年），总额达360亿美元。”英伟达未披露其通常承诺的可变现容量的具体比例，因此无法估算这360亿美元承诺下其计划供应的硬件价值。

items.title: X busts 200,000-strong Chinese bot farm, including accounts making claims about AI data centers and electricity — suspect accounts posted claims about pricing and grid strain to 'manipulate' debate
items.description: The X Safety Team said that at least 200 bot accounts have been making posts to influence public opinion data centers and energy policy. The accounts share links to legitimate news stories and then add their own spin designed to inflame emotions.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 28 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter X’s Global Government Affairs team posted on its account that it identified a 200,000-strong bot farm operating on the platform, with 200 of them posting information designed to influence public perception. According to the team, the accounts are suspected to have been created by Chinese operators, and that they’re using the accounts to amplify the negative impacts of AI data centers, especially on electricity prices.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsible“We identified a bot farm of approximately 200,000 accounts. Within this farm, we found 200 accounts posting in a manner that could manipulate a legitimate debate about American AI and energy policy,” the team said in its post on the platform. “These posts contained claims that AI data centers are driving up household electricity prices and straining the grid. Others included AI-generated cartoons that depicted data-center operators enriching themselves at the public's expense.”The X Safety team conducted an investigation into suspected Chinese inauthentic accounts involved in influence operations:We identified a bot farm of approximately 200,000 accounts. Within this farm, we found 200 accounts posting in a manner that could manipulate a legitimate… pic.twitter.com/Mj0SqerdlHAugust 28, 2026Some of the accounts shared by the team show names like Thomas Jackson, Patricia Robinson, Sandra Thompson, and Kenneth Flores, making it seem like they’re owned by Americans, and they’re sharing news stories from legitimate sources like The Southern Maryland Chronicle.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: For example, some of their posts share the story of how PJM Interconnection hiked its prices by 76% due to AI data center demand. However, they add commentary, and sometimes even include AI-generated images designed to inflame the emotions of someone just scrolling through their feed. One narrative they’re pushing is that the costs of putting up data centers are being borne by ordinary people as big tech companies enrich themselves.It’s unclear who sponsored or sanctioned the China-linked accounts on X, but there have been reports of China-linked operations designed to divide U.S. opinion on AI. However, the resistance against data centers isn’t all driven by Chinese propaganda, as billionaire investor Kevin O’Leary once claimed. In fact, a recent poll suggested that the biggest driver of data center protests is based on “object-level” local environmental and economic harms, especially as many other projects have shown the negative impacts they had on the community. You may like OpenAI bans China-linked ChatGPT accounts that amplified U.S. data center electricity price backlash China shifting massive AI data center complexes to rural provinces to tap surplus energy Polls reveal local utility hikes and noise drive US data center protests, not anti-AI sentiment The concerns that many residents have about data center developments in their area are indeed valid and true, but so is the threat of foreign intervention in domestic American politics. This is no surprise, though, as nation-states have always used propaganda and information to advance their own interests. The internet, social media, and artificial intelligence have made this easier in recent years, though, so both platforms and people need to be more vigilant than ever. items.titleZh: X busts 200,000-strong Chinese bot farm, including accounts making claims about AI data centers and electricity — suspect accounts posted claims about pricing and grid strain to 'manipulate' debate
items.descriptionZh:
X平台（原推特）的全球政府事务团队近日发布声明称，其在该平台上识别出一个规模约20万个账号的机器人农场（bot farm），其中约200个账号正以可能操纵美国AI与能源政策公开辩论的方式发帖。该团队指出，这些账号涉嫌由中国运营方创建，目的是利用社交平台放大AI数据中心的负面效应，尤其是对居民电价的影响，从而在公众中制造对立情绪。

据X安全团队调查，这200个活跃账号发布的帖子集中在以下几个叙事上：一是声称AI数据中心正在推高美国家庭电价并加剧电网负荷；二是配发AI生成的漫画或图像，将数据中心运营商描绘成以公共利益为代价中饱私囊的既得利益者。这些账号伪装成普通美国用户，使用如Thomas Jackson、Patricia Robinson、Sandra Thompson、Kenneth Flores等典型美国姓名，同时转发《南马里兰纪事报》（The Southern Maryland Chronicle）等合法新闻源的报道，以增强可信度。例如，它们会分享美国电力市场PJM Interconnection因AI数据中心需求上涨而将批发电价提升76%的新闻，但在转发时附加带有倾向性的评论，有时还嵌入AI生成的煽情图像，试图激化浏览者的情绪，推动“数据中心建设成本由普通民众承担、科技巨头趁机牟利”的论调。

关于这些关联中国账号的幕后资助者或授权方，目前尚不明确。此前已有报道指出，存在与中国相关的影响力操作，旨在分裂美国国内在AI政策上的舆论。然而，文章也强调，美国对数据中心建设的抵制并不完全由外国宣传驱动。尽管亿万富翁投资者Kevin O'Leary曾将抗议活动归因于外部势力，但近期民调显示，美国民众反对数据中心的最大驱动力其实来自于“具体层面”的本地环境与经济损害感知，例如噪音污染、基础设施压力以及当地公用事业费用上涨等问题。

文章最后指出，居民对数据中心在本地影响的担忧是真实且合理的，但外国势力干预美国内政的威胁同样确实存在。国家行为体历来利用宣传和信息手段推进自身利益，而互联网、社交媒体和人工智能技术近年来大大降低了这类操作的门槛。因此，平台方和普通用户都需要比以往任何时候更加警惕。这也提醒我们，在激烈的AI产业竞争中，技术设施建设已经不仅是经济或能源问题，更已成为信息战和舆论战的前沿阵地。

items.title: MSI MPG Ai1600TS PCIE5 1600W power supply review: GPU Safeguard+ protection with Titanium effeciency
items.description: MSI's flagship 1600W unit delivers confirmed Titanium efficiency, an all-Japanese component selection, and a genuinely novel approach to GPU power management, but the price tag demands serious justification.
items.content: MSI has built its PSU lineup steadily over the past several years, and the new MPG Ai1600TS PCIE5 currently sits at the top of that stack. At 1600 watts and with a retail price of about $500, it targets a narrow buyer profile: builders running power-hungry multi-GPU workstations, extreme overclockers, and system integrators who treat protection features as infrastructure rather than marketing copy. At this price and wattage, the bar is high, and a respectable label on the box is not enough.The platform, as with MSI's MAG series, comes from Channel-Well Technology (CWT), a Taiwanese OEM with a long and well-regarded history across mid-to-top-tier PSU design. Regardless, at this price range, even CWT’s involvement is a baseline assurance and not a selling point by itself. What matters here is the specification level MSI has chosen, and the Ai1600TS is built to a meaningfully higher standard than the MAG units. The distinction begins with the USB-C connector on the rear of the unit, which is the feature MSI has built its entire MPG marketing strategy around. Several PSU manufacturers have been trying to combat the plague of damaged 12V-2x6 connectors due to overcurrent and overheating – MSI’s approach, the GPU Safeguard/Safeguard+, fundamentally is per-wire current monitoring on the GPU connector. Let's examine the MSI MPG Ai1600TS PCIE5 to see if it is worthy of grabbing a spot in our best power supplies list.Specifications and Design Swipe to scroll horizontally MSI MPG Ai1600TS PCIE5 Power specifications ( Rated @ 40 °C ) RAIL +3.3V +5V +12V +5Vsb -12V MAX OUTPUT 22A 22A 133.33A 3A 0.A Row 2 - Cell 0 120W 120W 1599.96W 15W 0W TOTAL 1600W Row 3 - Cell 2 Row 3 - Cell 3 Row 3 - Cell 4 Row 3 - Cell 5 AC INPUT 100 - 240 VAC, 50 - 60 Hz Row 4 - Cell 2 Row 4 - Cell 3 Row 4 - Cell 4 Row 4 - Cell 5 MSRP $ 500 Row 5 - Cell 2 Row 5 - Cell 3 Row 5 - Cell 4 Row 5 - Cell 5 Today's best MSI MPG Ai1600TS PCIE5 PSU deals $499.99View $499.99View No price informationCheck Best BuyWe check over 250 million products every day for the best pricesIn the BoxThe outer packaging is a large, sturdy cardboard box with a blue and purple color scheme and a photograph of the unit on the front. Inside, the unit sits in a synthetic pouch surrounded by foam inserts on both ends. The presentation is confident and visually excessive, hinting at the visuals of the unit itself.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)MSI MPG Ai1600TS PCIE5 PSU at Newegg for $499.99The bundle is unexpectedly Spartan for a unit at this price. Mounting screws, an AC power cable with a NEMA C19 connector, and a few cable ties are what you get. No additional accessories, not even cable ties – with such a price tag we believe that buyers have every right to expect more. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Setting the frugal bundle aside, cable quality is outstanding. All cables are fully modular, all-black from connector to tip, and use MSI's “embossed jacket” wires, which give them a scaled, textured appearance. Cable combs are preinstalled on all cables except the SATA and PATA lines. The connector count is genuinely strong even for this power class: two 12V-2x6 connectors and seven 6+2 pin PCI Express connectors. Five of the PCIe connectors arrive on individual cables, while the sixth cable carries two 6+2 connectors in a piggyback arrangement. Having two 12V-2x6 connectors is the minimum we expect on a 1600W unit and the Ai1600TS did not disappoint. Both 12V-2x6 connectors use a dual-color design with a yellow lower section that vanishes entirely once the connector is fully seated, providing an unambiguous visual confirmation of complete insertion. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Swipe to scroll horizontally MSI MPG Ai1600TS PCIE5 Connector type Hardwired Modular ATX 24 Pin - 1 EPS 4+4 Pin - 1 EPS 8 Pin - 1 PCI-E 5.0 - 2 PCI-E 8 Pin - 7 SATA - 8 Molex - 4 Floppy - - External AppearanceAt 190mm in length, the Ai1600TS is substantially longer than the ATX design guide's recommendation and will not fit in compact enclosures. Case compatibility should be verified before purchase. The chassis carries a satin black paint finish that is applied evenly across all surfaces with no visible inconsistencies or runs. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)The aesthetic is deliberately complex. The fan finger guard is formed directly from the chassis itself, shaped by parallel trapezoidal cutouts running the diagonal of the intake face. Purple and white fonts and decorative elements appear on nearly every external surface. Glossy stickers cover the left and right side panels, and the top surface carries the standard electrical specifications and certifications label.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsors (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)The front panel holds only the rocker switch and the NEMA C20 AC receptacle. The rear panel houses the modular connector array with a white legend printed alongside each socket group, and notably, a USB Type-C port. That connector is the hardware expression of the Ai1600TS's defining feature. Image 1 of 2 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 2 View Original Image 2 of 2 View Original The USB-C port links the PSU directly to the motherboard, enabling two-way communication between the unit and MSI's Afterburner software. On the monitoring side, this means real-time visibility into output parameters that would otherwise require a separate inline meter or dedicated hardware. On the control side, it allows basic operational parameters to be adjusted from within the software environment rather than requiring physical intervention.More significantly, it is the foundation for Safeguard+, MSI's GPU protection system. On the MAG series, Safeguard+ operates as a connector-level OCP trigger - when a threshold is breached, the system shuts down. On the MPG series, the communication channel allows the PSU to react differently. Rather than cutting power entirely, the unit signals the motherboard to reduce GPU power draw in real time (throttling), keeping the system running while bringing consumption back within safe limits. A physical buzzer on the unit provides an audible alert when a Safeguard event occurs. For workloads that push GPU hardware continuously, the difference between a controlled throttle and a full system shutdown is operationally significant, and probably is the primary justification MSI can claim for the price premium over the MAG lineup.Internal DesignThe Ai1600TS is cooled by a Power Logic PLA13525S12H 135mm fan running a fluid dynamic bearing engine. FDB remains the most practical bearing technology for high-wattage units where both acoustics and service life matter. The rated maximum speed of 2300 RPM is high for this fan diameter but not unusual given the sustained thermal load a 1600W design must manage. MSI has added a rotation sensor that triggers an audible buzzer if the fan stops, as well as real-time fan monitoring and profile control via the Afterburner application. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)The unit is built by CWT, a Taiwanese OEM with several decades of experience producing mid-to-top-tier PSU platforms for major brands. Channel-Well's track record is well established and generally positive; their designs have underpinned well-regarded units across multiple product generations. Image 1 of 2 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 2 View Original Image 2 of 2 View Original Input filtering is adequate for the class, with four Y capacitors, two X capacitors, and two common-mode inductors. Two rectifying bridges are installed on the largest heatsink along the board edge. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)The APFC stage uses four Toshiba K040N60Z1/K015N65C MOSFETs alongside two diodes in a semi-digital, load-based topology, mounted on the same large heatsink as the rectifying bridges. The passive components consist of two large encased inductors and three bulk capacitors, two Nippon Chemi-Con 680μF units and one Rubycon 470μF. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Primary inversion is handled by four Alpha & Omega TF095A60 MOSFETs in a full-bridge topology, mounted on a dedicated heatsink directly ahead of the main transformers. The secondary side generates the 12V rail using twelve Vishay Dale SiRS4600DP MOSFETs in a synchronous rectification topology, arranged on two vertical PCBs next to the main transformers. DC-to-DC converters on a separate daughterboard produce the 3.3V and 5V lines. All electrolytic and solid-state capacitors on the secondary side are sourced from Nippon Chemi-Con and Rubycon exclusively, making this an entirely Japanese passive component design. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Cold Test Results (25°C Ambient)Cold Test Results (25°C Ambient)For the testing of PSUs, we are using high-precision electronic loads with a maximum power draw of 2700 Watts, a Rigol DS5042M 40 MHz oscilloscope, an Extech 380803 power analyzer, two high-precision UNI-T UT-325 digital thermometers, an Extech HD600 SPL meter, a self-designed hotbox, and various other bits and parts. Image 1 of 5 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 5 View Original Image 2 of 5 View Original Image 3 of 5 View Original Image 4 of 5 View Original Image 5 of 5 View Original At 115 VAC, average nominal load efficiency is 92.9%. At 230 VAC, it reaches 93.8%. Both figures comfortably satisfy the Cybenetics and CLEAResult Titanium certification thresholds at 115 VAC. As a matter of fact, it flirts with the Cybenetics Diamond certification at 115 VAC. The 230 VAC result is a little harder to explain, as our sample easily met the Cybenetics Titanium figures, yet the Ai1600TS holds a Cybenetics Platinum certification for 230 VAC input. Efficiency peaks at approximately 50% load, while low-load efficiency is very good as well.The fan begins spinning at just above 30% load but is effectively inaudible throughout most of the operating range. There is a speed increase approaching full load, but the unit does not become acoustically prominent under cold ambient conditions. Thermal performance is excellent.Hot Test Results (~45°C Ambient)Hot Test Results (~45°C Ambient)At 115 VAC under elevated ambient conditions, average nominal efficiency drops to 91.4%. At 230 VAC, it falls to 92.3%. The degradation is measurable but reasonable, and there are no signs of thermal stress despite the 40°C rating. The unit handles the step-up in ambient temperature without any indication that it is approaching its thermal limits, which is a meaningful result for a 1600W design. Image 1 of 5 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 5 View Original Image 2 of 5 View Original Image 3 of 5 View Original Image 4 of 5 View Original Image 5 of 5 View Original Fan behavior shifts as expected. Under hot conditions, the fan begins spinning at 20% load rather than 30%, and it ramps more quickly than in cold testing. It does not, however, reach maximum speed even at 100% load, which is an exceptionally strong result for a 1600 watt unit. Thermal performance under these conditions is outstanding for the power class.PSU Quality and Bottom LinePower Supply QualityVoltage regulation is very good by current standards. The 12V rail holds to within 0.9% across the full load range, and both the 5V and 3.3V rails regulate to within 0.6%. All three figures sit comfortably below the 1% threshold that characterizes a well-executed high-end design. Ripple filtering is good but not exceptional. The 12V rail peaks at 46mV, the 5V rail at 26mV, and the 3.3V rail at 24mV. All three figures clear the ATX specification limits by a meaningful margin, but stronger ripple suppression on the 12V line would be expected at such a price.During our routine evaluation, we examine the fundamental protection features of all power supply units we review, including Over Current Protection (OCP), Over Voltage Protection (OVP), Over Power Protection (OPP), and Short Circuit Protection (SCP).Protection circuit behavior is conservative but sound. The 3.3V OCP triggers at 130% of rated current, and the 5V OCP at 128%. The 12V OCP activates at just 116%, which is a tighter margin than seen on many competing units and leaves less headroom for transient load spikes, though it does not present a practical problem for normal high-load operation. OPP under hot conditions engages at 118% of rated output, a conservative and responsible threshold given the wattage involved. The component selection is impeccable, the efficiency is confirmed comfortably reaching Titanium levels, the thermal performance under sustained load is genuinely impressive, and the Safeguard+ implementation on the MPG platform is a functionally distinct feature with real operational value for users pushing GPU hardware continuously. The 12-year warranty is one of the longest in the industry and reflects a manufacturer that stands behind the build quality. These are not incremental improvements over lower-tier offerings; they are substantive differences. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)The component selection deserves specific mention. Nippon Chemi-Con and Rubycon capacitors throughout the secondary side are not a given at any price point, and these are paired with silicon like Vishay Dale MOSFETs on the secondary side and Toshiba silicon in the APFC stage. The Ai1600TS reads like a bill of materials assembled without negotiation on component quality. That matters for long-term reliability in a way that efficiency figures and marketing language cannot fully capture. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)The overall performance results are very good, although they undeniably could have been better. The stock fan curve is well-tuned, conservative enough to remain inaudible through most of the operating range and never reaches its ceiling even at maximum load under elevated ambient conditions. For a 1600W unit, that is quite rare. Voltage regulation across all three rails is tight, and the thermal testing produced no signs of stress even under sustained full load in a hot environment. Power quality is very good, but we would have liked to see better ripple filtering at this price point. The price, however, is a serious obstacle.Retailing at $500, the Ai1600TS costs more than twice what comparably performing units typically ask, and the premium is driven almost entirely by the digital interface and the Afterburner ecosystem rather than raw electrical performance. Buyers who have no interest in Safeguard+ integration or real-time software monitoring are effectively paying a large surcharge for features they will never use. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)The unit delivers on every technical promise MSI makes for it. However, the value equation requires careful consideration. At $500, the pricing is reasonable and competitive, landing significantly below the Seasonic Prime TX-1600 Noctua Edition and MSI’s own MEG AI1600T Titanium, undercutting both a major rival and MSI’s flagship. On the other hand, those shopping for a $500+ unit are hardly ever limited by budget and their selection criteria lie elsewhere.Builders who specifically need the Safeguard+ GPU communication feature, who intend to run sustained maximum loads in thermally demanding enclosures, and who are investing in a long-term platform where the 12-year warranty carries genuine weight, may find the MPG Ai1600TS PCIE5 a justifiable purchase.MORE: Best Power SuppliesMORE: How We Test Power SuppliesMORE: All Power Supply ContentMSI MPG Ai1600TS PCIE5 PSU: Price Comparison $499.99View $499.99View $499.99View No price informationCheck Best BuyWe check over 250 million products every day for the best pricespowered by

items.titleZh: MSI MPG Ai1600TS PCIE5 1600W power supply review: GPU Safeguard+ protection with Titanium effeciency
items.descriptionZh:
微星（MSI）近年来稳步扩充其电源产品线，最新推出的MPG Ai1600TS PCIE5目前位居该系列金字塔尖。这款额定功率1600瓦、建议零售价约500美元的产品，瞄准的是相当狭窄的买家群体：运行高功耗多显卡工作站的专业装机者、极限超频玩家，以及将保护功能视为基础设施而非宣传话术的系统集成商。在如此价位和功率级别，评判标准自然极高，包装盒上印个响亮名号远远不够。

该电源平台与MAG系列一样，出自台湾OEM厂商Channel-Well Technology（CWT），这家公司在电源设计中高端领域耕耘数十年，口碑良好。不过在这个价位段，CWT的参与只能算基础保障，并非卖点本身。真正关键的是微星选择的规格等级——Ai1600TS的用料标准明显高于MAG系列。最直观的区别是电源背面的USB-C接口，这也是微星整个MPG系列营销策略的核心。近年来，多家电源厂商都在设法应对12V-2x6接口因过流和过热导致的烧毁问题，微星的方案名为“GPU Safeguard/Safeguard+”，其本质是对显卡供电接口的每根线缆进行独立电流监测。Tom's Hardware评测室对该电源进行了全面测试，以判断它是否有资格跻身最佳电源榜单。

**规格与设计**

在40℃额定温度下，+3.3V和+5V输出均为22A（合计120W），+12V输出高达133.33A（1599.96W），+5Vsb为3A，-12V为0.3A，总功率1600W。交流输入支持100-240VAC、50-60Hz。MSRP为500美元，目前实际售价约499.99美元。

外包装是一个蓝紫配色的大号硬纸盒，正面印有产品照片。内部电源置于合成纤维袋中，两端由泡沫固定，开箱仪式感十足且略显张扬。不过配件部分令人意外地简陋：仅有安装螺丝、一根带NEMA C19接口的交流电源线和几条扎带。在这个价位，没有额外附件甚至连理线梳都没有，确实令人觉得买家有权期待更多。

线材质量则相当出色。所有线缆均为全模组设计，从接头到端子通体黑色，采用微星“压纹外套”导线，表面有鳞片状纹理。除SATA和PATA线外，所有线缆均预装理线梳。接口数量在这个功率级别相当充裕：两个12V-2x6接口和七个6+2针PCI Express接口。其中五条PCIe线缆各带一个接头，第六条线缆以并联方式搭载两个6+2针接头。两个12V-2x6接口是1600W电源的标配底线，Ai1600TS没有让人失望。两个12V-2x6接头采用双色设计，下半部分为黄色，完全插紧后黄色部分消失，提供一目了然的插入确认。

**外部观感**

电源长度190mm，远超ATX设计指南推荐尺寸，无法装入紧凑型机箱，购买前必须确认机箱兼容性。机箱采用均匀的哑光黑色烤漆，表面无可见瑕疵或流痕。外观设计刻意追求复杂层次：风扇防护网由机箱本体直接冲压成型，以平行梯形开孔沿进风面对角线排列；几乎所有外表面都有紫色和白色字体及装饰元素；左右侧板覆盖有光泽贴纸，顶面印有标准电气规格和认证标签。

前面板仅有翘板开关和NEMA C20交流电插座。后面板是模组接口阵列，每个插座组旁印有白色标识，最引人注目的是一个USB Type-C端口——这正是Ai1600TS核心特色的硬件载体。USB-C接口将电源直接连接至主板，实现电源与微星Afterburner软件之间的双向通信。监控方面，用户可以实时查看输出参数，而以往这需要单独的内联仪表或专用硬件；控制方面，可以在软件界面内调整基本运行参数，无需物理操作。

更重要的是，它是Safeguard+（微星GPU保护系统）的基础。在MAG系列上，Safeguard+仅是接口级的OCP触发机制——一旦超过阈值，系统直接关机。而在MPG系列上，通信通道让电源能以不同方式应对：不是完全切断电源，而是电源向主板发送信号，实时降低GPU功耗（即降频），让系统继续运行同时将功耗拉回安全范围。电源内置物理蜂鸣器，在Safeguard事件发生时发出声音警报。对于那些让GPU持续满载的工作负载，受控降频与彻底关机之间的差别具有实际意义，这很可能是微星为MPG系列相对MAG系列溢价的主要理由。

**内部设计**

Ai1600TS采用Power Logic PLA13525S12H 135mm风扇，使用流体动态轴承（FDB）技术。FDB仍是高功率电源最实用的轴承方案，兼顾噪音与寿命。2300 RPM的额定最高转速对该直径风扇而言偏高，但考虑到1600W设计需承受的持续热负载，这并不罕见。微星还加入了旋转传感器，若风扇停转将触发蜂鸣器报警；同时支持通过Afterburner实时监控风扇转速和调整风扇曲线。

该电源由CWT制造，这家台湾OEM拥有数十年中高端电源平台设计经验，历史上为多个主流品牌产出过备受好评的产品。输入滤波在该级别中规中矩：四个Y电容、两个X电容和两个共模电感。两颗整流桥安装在外侧最大的散热片上。APFC（有源功率因数校正）级采用四颗东芝K040N60Z1/K015N65C MOSFET搭配两颗二极管，构成半数字、基于负载的拓扑结构，与整流桥共用同一大型散热片。被动元件包括两个大型封装电感和三个主电容：两颗日本贵弥功（Nippon Chemi-Con）680μF和一颗Rubycon（红宝石）470μF。一次侧逆变由四颗Alpha & Omega TF095A60 MOSFET组成全桥拓扑，安装于主变压器正前方的专用散热片上。二次侧通过十二颗Vishay Dale SiRS4600DP MOSFET以同步整流拓扑生成12V轨，这些MOSFET排列在主变压器旁边的两块垂直PCB上。3.3V和5V由独立子板上的DC-DC转换器产生。二次侧全部电解电容和固态电容均来自Nippon Chemi-Con和Rubycon，这意味着整个被动元件体系为全日本制造。

**冷态测试结果（25℃环境）**

测试设备包括最大功耗2700瓦的高精度电子负载、Rigol DS5042M 40MHz示波器、Extech 380803功率分析仪、两台高精度UNI-T UT-325数字温度计、Extech HD600声级计、自设计热箱等。在115VAC电压下，平均标称负载效率为92.9%；在230VAC下达93.8%。两项数据均轻松满足Cybenetics和CLEAResult在115VAC下的钛金认证要求，甚至接近Cybenetics钻石认证。230VAC下的结果则略显费解——样机轻松达到Cybenetics钛金水平，但Ai1600TS实际持有的是230VAC下的Cybenetics铂金认证。效率在约50%负载时达到峰值，低负载效率也非常出色。

风扇在略高于30%负载时开始旋转，但整个工作区间内基本听不到声音。接近满载时转速上升，但在冷态环境下并不吵人。散热表现优秀。

**热态测试结果（约45℃环境）**

在升高的环境温度下，115VAC平均标称效率降至91.4%，230VAC降至92.3%。性能衰减可测量但合理，尽管额定温度为40℃，却没有任何热应力迹象。电源在环境温度上升时表现从容，完全没有接近热极限的迹象——这对1600W级别的设计来说意义重大。

风扇行为如预期般变化。热态下风扇从20%负载即开始旋转（而非冷态时的30%），转速提升也更快。但即使在100%负载下也未达到最高转速，这对1600W电源来说是极其出色的结果。该功率级别下热性能相当杰出。

**电源质量与最终结论**

电压调节按当前标准非常出色：12V轨在全负载范围内波动保持在0.9%以内，5V和3.3V轨均在0.6%以内，三项数据都稳稳低于高端设计1%的优秀阈值。纹波抑制良好但不算顶级：12V轨峰值46mV，5V轨26mV，3.3V轨24mV，均大幅低于ATX规范限值，但在如此价位下12V纹波本可期望更强的抑制能力。

保护电路行为保守但合理：3.3V OCP在额定电流的130%触发，5V OCP在128%触发，12V OCP仅116%即启动——这一余量比许多竞品更紧，留给瞬态负载尖峰的空间较小，但正常高负载运行不会遇到实际问题。热态下OPP（过功率保护）在额定输出的118%启动，考虑到功率之大，这是一个保守且负责的阈值。

**核心数据速览**：负载从20%（322.59W）到50%（805.14W）、75%（1201.59W）、100%（1598.5W），12V电压保持在11.98-12.09V之间，3.3V保持3.32-3.34V，5V保持5.07-5.10V。线路调节率：3.3V为0.6%，5V为0.6%，12V为0.9%。纹波方面，12V从20%负载的24mV上升至满载的46mV，5V在22-26mV之间，3.3V在20-24mV之间。

**最终评价**

MSI MPG Ai1600TS PCIE5是一款技术上非常成熟的电源。元件选择无可挑剔，效率稳定达到钛金水平，持续负载下的散热表现令人印象深刻，MPG平台上的Safeguard+实现是一个功能上真正独特、对持续压榨GPU的用户具有实际价值的特性。12年质保是业内最长之一，反映了厂商对自身制造质量的信心。这些并非相对低端产品的渐进式改进，而是实质性差异。

元件选择值得特别指出：二次侧全Nippon Chemi-Con和Rubycon电容在任何价位都不是理所当然的，搭配Vishay Dale MOSFET和APFC级东芝MOSFET，Ai1600TS的物料清单看起来像是在元件品质上毫无妥协地敲定的。这对长期可靠性的意义，远非效率数字和营销语言所能完全体现。

整体性能表现非常出色，但不可否认仍有提升空间。原厂风扇曲线调校得当，在整个工作区间内足够保守保持静音，即使在高环境温度下满载也从未触及转速上限——这在1600W电源中相当罕见。三路电压调节精准，热测试在恶劣环境下满载运行也没有任何压力迹象。电源质量非常好，但在这个价位我们期望更好的纹波滤波。然而，价格是一个严肃的障碍。

500美元的零售价是同性能电源通常价格的两倍以上，溢价几乎完全来自数字接口和Afterburner生态系统，而非电气性能本身。对Safeguard+集成或实时软件监控没有兴趣的买家，实际上是在为永远不会使用的功能支付高昂附加费。另一方面，这个定价也具备合理性和竞争力——它明显低于Seasonic Prime TX-1600 Noctua Edition和微星自家的MEG AI1600T Titanium，同时压过了主要竞争对手和自家旗舰。不过，预算能到500美元以上的买家很少受价格限制，他们的选购标准在别处。

需要Safeguard+显卡通信功能、打算在散热要求苛刻的机箱中长时间跑满载、并且看重12年质保所代表的长期投资价值的装机者，会发现MPG Ai1600TS PCIE5物有所值。

items.title: Google clamps down on Android app RAM usage amid AI memory crisis — developers have until February 2027 to adapt to new memory-optimizing rules
items.description: Google implements stricter memory limits and introduces new performance standards for Android apps.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 2 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Because of the unprecedented memory shortage, Google has introduced stricter guidelines for how Android applications manage and use device memory. These new rules ensure applications perform smoothly across a wider range of devices, especially those with lower memory capacities. Developers now have until February 2027 to optimize their applications to reduce the memory footprint.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI shortages (Image credit: Nvidia)AI data centers are swallowing the world's memory and storage supplyDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleChip scarcity assaults auto industry amid the worsening Nexperia and DRAM crisisThe custom AI ASIC state of playSmartphone manufacturers are managing the limited supply and rising costs of memory and storage components in different ways. Some are reducing the memory or storage included in their smartphones, while others are passing the additional costs directly on to consumers. Before the global memory shortage, it was not uncommon to find entry-level smartphones equipped with 6GB to 8GB of memory. However, many manufacturers have dialed memory down to 4GB, which will ultimately significantly impact device performance.Google’s new memory limits are meant to help guarantee a smooth experience on smartphones with limited memory. If an application exceeds the predefined memory thresholds, the Android operating system will intervene by slowing down the application or forcibly closing it to prevent slowdowns or crashes. Google has called on developers to optimize three crucial areas: dynamic memory usage (anonymous RSS + swap), bitmap memory usage, and DEX code.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Dynamic memory usage refers to the temporary memory that an application consumes while it is running. Developers need to implement smarter memory management so memory is freed when it is no longer needed. This can be when the user is no longer interacting with the application or when it moves to the background.Bitmap memory usage is another key area that developers must focus on. Bitmaps are common resources for displaying vibrant images, but they consume far more memory than displaying text. When overdone, excessive bitmap memory usage can easily eat up a device's memory. Google recommends that developers use bitmaps responsibly and use better image handling protocols. Unnecessary code just increases the memory footprint. Under the new guidelines, developers must clean and shrink the application's code by at least 25% with tools such as R8 before publishing the application on the Google Play Store.Just as computer enthusiasts are reluctant to buy new hardware, smartphone users are in the same boat when it comes to upgrading their devices. items.titleZh: Google clamps down on Android app RAM usage amid AI memory crisis — developers have until February 2027 to adapt to new memory-optimizing rules
items.descriptionZh:
由于全球范围内的内存芯片供应紧张，AI数据中心的建设正在大量吞噬内存和存储产能，加上消费端CPU需求激增，以及汽车产业面临的芯片短缺危机，整个市场正经历一场前所未有的内存短缺。这一状况直接影响了智能手机行业。过去，入门级手机普遍配备6GB至8GB内存，但如今许多厂商为了控制成本和应对供应限制，已经将内存缩减到4GB，这无疑会对设备性能产生明显影响。面对这种情况，手机厂商不得不采取不同策略：要么减少手机自带的内存或存储容量，要么将上涨的硬件成本直接转嫁给消费者。

为了缓解硬件短缺带来的体验问题，Google 针对 Android 应用推出了更严格的内存管理规范。这一新政策的核心理念是：在有限的内存资源下，确保应用依然能够在尽可能广泛的设备上流畅运行，尤其是那些低内存机型。Google 给开发者设定的优化截止日期为2027年2月，要求他们在此之前缩减应用的内存占用空间。如果应用超出系统设定的内存阈值，Android 系统将会主动介入——要么降低应用运行速度，要么直接强制关闭，以避免整个设备出现卡顿或崩溃。Google 重点要求优化三个关键技术领域：动态内存使用（包括匿名 RSS 与 swap）、位图内存使用，以及 DEX 代码。

首先，动态内存指的是应用在运行期间所分配的临时内存。开发者需要实现更智能的内存管理机制，在用户不再交互或应用转入后台时及时释放不再需要的内存，而不是让无效内存持续占用资源。第二个方面是位图内存。位图是显示图片和丰富视觉内容时常用的资源，但它的内存消耗远高于纯文本，如果使用不当，很容易在短时间内耗尽设备内存。Google 建议开发者负起责任地使用位图，并采纳更高效的图像处理协议来减少内存占用。第三个领域是代码优化。很多应用在开发过程中会积累大量冗余或未被使用的代码，这些没用的代码只会白白增加内存负担。根据新规，开发者在发布应用到 Google Play 商店前，必须使用 R8 等工具对代码进行清理和瘦身，将应用代码体积至少缩减25%。

这一系列举措与整个科技行业的趋势高度一致。当前，无论是传统 PC 用户还是智能手机用户，都表现出不愿频繁升级硬件的倾向。因此，厂商们更倾向于通过对软件层面的优化来提升用户在现有设备上的体验。比如，微软已经承诺优化 Windows 11，使其能够在 8GB 内存的设备上流畅运行，从而避免用户被迫升级硬件。Google 的最新内存政策也是同样的思路：强制 Android 应用开发者遵循更高效的内存使用规范，从源头降低应用对设备硬件的需求。这样不仅让低内存手机用户受益，在一定程度上也能缓解整个生态对内存芯片的过度依赖。

这项政策的影响是深远的。对开发者而言，必须在规定时间内对应用进行架构层面的调整，优化内存和代码资源，这可能会在短期内增加开发工作量，但将提升应用在各类设备上的兼容性和稳定性。对用户而言，最直接的收益是旧手机或低端手机能够维持更长的使用寿命和更稳定的表现，尤其是在当前内存价格高企、硬件升级成本昂贵的时期。长远来看，这种软硬件协同优化的思路，或许会成为行业应对供应链危机的常态化手段之一。

items.description: SK hynix breaks ground on HBM assembly plant in the U.S. that will form a connection between DRAM wafers produced in South Korea and their consumers among AI companies in the U.S.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter High-bandwidth memory (HBM) is one of the key components of AI systems that is not currently assembled in the U.S., but this is going to change in 2029, when SK hynix initiates packaging of HBM memory modules at its facility in Indiana. This week, the company held a groundbreaking ceremony for its HBM production base in America and intends to start construction of the plant shortly.Tom's Hardware Premium Roadmaps (Image credit: Future)Leading-edge foundry roadmapsNvidia Enterprise GPU and CPU roadmapAMD's Enterprise GPU and CPU roadmapIntel's roadmaps examined — 14A, Nova Lake, Diamond Rapids & AI accelerator pushCo-Packaged Optics (CPO) foundry roadmapsSK hynix's HBM production site in West Lafayette, Indiana, will specialize in advanced packaging, testing, and R&D of HBM. The facility is set to cost the company around $4 billion, which highlights its advanced technology capabilities as well as vast capacity. The DRAM maker expects to open the cleanroom by October 2028 and begin volume production of next-generation HBM in the second half of 2029, which is about a year later than originally envisioned. Once commercial operations kick off, SK hynix expects the Indiana site to employ around 1,000 people.Despite being described as an HBM production base, the Indiana site will not manufacture the DRAM wafers, but will package HBM stacks using DRAM wafers produced in South Korea and base dies produced in South Korea, Taiwan, or the U.S. Nonetheless, SK hynix intends to market the resulting devices as its first U.S.-made next-generation HBM products. Meanwhile, as custom HBM-class memory gains traction in the second half of the decade, assembling such stacks close to American customers may be particularly important both for SK hynix and its clients, as it enables SK hynix to shrink the feedback loop significantly.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: In addition to building the advanced packaging and testing plant, SK hynix will also establish an Advanced Packaging R&D Testbed next to the manufacturing lines. The facility will enable SK hynix to work with customers, universities, and commercial partners on future packaging technologies, build prototypes, and quickly validate their performance and manufacturability in an actual production environment. In the era of customized HBM, such a facility could become a significant competitive advantage for SK hynix.SK hynix also signed a memorandum of understanding with Purdue University to jointly research system integration and advanced packaging technologies, including HBM. items.titleZh: SK hynix breaks ground on the first HBM plant in the US, bringing key AI component production to the States — says production starts in 2029
items.descriptionZh:
高带宽内存（HBM）是当前AI系统中不可或缺的关键组件，但长期以来其封装环节并未在美国本土进行。这一局面将在2029年迎来改变——SK海力士计划在其位于印第安纳州的工厂启动HBM内存模组的封装生产。本周，该公司已为这座美国HBM生产基地举行了奠基仪式，并将于近期正式开始厂房建设。

这座基地位于印第安纳州西拉法叶，总投资约40亿美元，将专注于HBM的先进封装、测试及研发工作。SK海力士预计，洁净室将于2028年10月建成，并计划在2029年下半年启动下一代HBM的量产，这一时间表比最初设想晚了大约一年。工厂全面投产后，预计将为当地创造约1000个就业岗位。

需要特别指出的是，尽管号称HBM生产基地，该工厂并不制造DRAM晶圆，而是利用在韩国生产的DRAM晶圆以及来自韩国、台湾或美国的基底芯片（base die）进行HBM堆叠的封装。尽管如此，SK海力士仍将把由此产出的产品宣传为其首款“美国制造”的下一代HBM。随着定制化HBM类内存在本十年后半段逐渐兴起，将此类堆叠模组的组装环节贴近美国客户，无论对SK海力士还是其客户而言都意义重大——这能显著缩短反馈回路，使产品迭代和问题响应更加高效。

除了先进的封装与测试产线，SK海力士还将在制造线旁设立一个“先进封装研发试验基地”。该设施将使公司能够与客户、高校及商业伙伴协作，共同探索未来的封装技术，制作原型，并在真实生产环境中快速验证其性能与可制造性。在定制化HBM时代，这样的设施有望成为SK海力士的重要竞争优势。

此外，SK海力士还与普渡大学签署了谅解备忘录，双方将围绕系统集成和先进封装技术（包括HBM）展开联合研究。SK海力士首席执行官郭鲁正（Kwak Noh-Jung）表示：“美国是AI创新的中心，汇聚了一流客户、顶尖研发能力和合作伙伴。印第安纳工厂将成为交付首款‘美国制造’HBM产品的门户。我们将扩大在美国的投资与合作，共同成长，成为塑造美国AI未来最值得信赖的伙伴。”

这一动向也回应了美国在AI供应链上的长期短板——尽管美国在芯片设计、制造及系统集成方面实力雄厚，但HBM封装这一关键环节长期依赖亚洲产能。SK海力士此次布局，不仅是对美国本土产能的补充，更凸显了在定制化存储与先进封装竞争日趋激烈的背景下，贴近客户进行创新协作的战略思路。

history.titleZh: 铁电调谐减少LLM训练中的光互连停顿（佐治亚理工学院）
history.descriptionZh:
近几年，大语言模型（LLM）的规模急剧膨胀，尤其是混合专家（MoE）架构的兴起，使得模型参数达到万亿级别，训练时需要在数千乃至数万个加速器之间进行大量的激活和梯度交换。为了突破传统电互连在带宽、延迟和能耗上的瓶颈，晶圆级光互连技术应运而生——将光收发器件直接集成在硅晶圆上，以极高密度和超大带宽实现芯片间通信。然而，光互连器件（如微环谐振器、马赫-曾德尔调制器）的工作波长对温度极其敏感，环境变化或高功率光信号都会导致波长漂移，必须依赖热调谐（通过加热元件改变材料折射率）将器件波长对准至激光源。这一过程不仅消耗大量电力，还会造成通信阶段的“调谐停顿”——在每次数据交换前，系统必须暂时中止数据传输，等待热调谐完成，从而严重拖慢MoE训练的整体速度。

针对这一问题，佐治亚理工学院的研究团队发表了一篇题为《Thermal Tuning Overhead in Wafer-Scale Optical Interconnects for LLM MoE Training: A Cross-Layer Analysis and Ferroelectric-Based Mitigation》的技术论文。论文首先对晶圆级光互连在MoE训练场景下的热调谐开销进行了跨层分析——从底层器件物理特性、电路设计，到上层通信模式与训练调度策略，全面揭示了反复出现的调谐停顿是如何在通信阶段累积成巨大性能损失的。作者指出，在MoE训练中，通信是频繁且突发性的，每个token都要经过路由器动态选择专家，导致通信模式高度不规则，这进一步放大了热调谐带来的同步开销。

论文的核心创新点在于引入铁电材料来替代传统纯热调谐机制。铁电材料具有非易失的自发极化特性，其极化状态可通过外加电场翻转并稳定保持，从而快速改变材料的折射率或光波导的有效介电常数。基于这一原理，研究者设计了一种铁电辅助的光调谐器件：在极低功耗下通过电压脉冲实现波长快速校准，且不需要持续加热维持状态，从根本上消除了热惯性带来的等待时间。相比传统热调谐器（毫秒级响应、持续功耗），铁电调谐器具有纳秒或微秒级响应速度、近乎零的静态功耗，并能在断电后保持调谐状态，非常适合高频次、短时间的通信间隙。论文将此技术应用于晶圆级光互连系统，并与跨层设计的电路控制策略结合，使得通信阶段的调谐停顿大幅减少。

性能方面，论文报告了显著的加速效果：在MoE大模型训练典型工作负载下，所提出的铁电调谐方案实现了最高2.7倍的训练速度提升。这一提升并非来自单纯某一层的改进，而是通过跨层联合优化——在器件层面用铁电调谐降低延迟，在电路层面设计高效的电压驱动与状态切换机制，在系统层面调整通信调度以充分利用快速调谐的特性——才最终获得的。虽然2.7倍是一个聚合指标，但论文还强调了它意味着在通信密集的专家并行（EP）配置中，原本占训练总时间近一半的通信等待时间被大幅压缩，从而使GPU/加速器的计算资源得到更充分的利用。

该研究对大规模AI训练基础设施的设计具有重要指导意义。随着MoE模型成为主流，晶圆级光互连是下一代AI超级计算机的关键技术之一，而热调谐开销很可能成为其规模化部署的“暗礁”。该项工作首次系统地量化了这一开销，并提出基于铁电材料的集成解决方案，为开发低功耗、快速响应、高可靠的光互连提供了一条可行路径。除了LLM训练，该技术还可用于多模态大模型训练、大规模推理集群，以及未来的光学算力互联、光交换数据中心等场景——凡是需要高带宽、低延迟、低成本光通信的地方，都可能从铁电调谐技术中受益。当然，论文中的方案仍面临硅基铁电材料（如HfZrOx）的集成工艺成熟度、规模化良率等挑战，但这一研究方向无疑为超大规模AI算力集群性价比提升打开了新的空间。

history.titleZh: 生成式设计优化2.5D和3D封装的液冷通道（密歇根大学迪尔伯恩分校）
history.descriptionZh:
随着人工智能、高性能计算和先进制程的持续演进，2.5D与3D集成封装已成为突破芯片性能瓶颈的关键技术路线。然而，多芯片堆叠和高功率密度带来的严峻热挑战，正成为系统可靠性与性能发挥的核心制约因素。针对这一问题，密歇根大学迪尔伯恩分校（University of Michigan-Dearborn）的研究人员发表了一篇题为《Generative Design of Liquid-Cooling Channels for Thermal Management of 2.5D and 3D Integrated Advanced Packaging》的技术论文，提出了一种基于物理引导的生成式设计框架，用于液冷通道的拓扑优化，从而实现更高效的散热方案。

该研究聚焦于一个功率高达2.7千瓦的多芯片封装系统，其中包含两颗高功率GPU和一颗CPU。在如此高的总功耗下，传统风冷或简单液冷方案难以有效控制热点温度，尤其是在2.5D/3D封装中，芯片间通过硅中介层或垂直堆叠方式互联，热耦合效应显著，热量传递路径复杂。论文提出的生成式设计方法并非依赖传统经验式通道布局，而是将流体力学、传热学等物理规律嵌入生成式算法中，在给定封装结构、热源分布和冷却液约束条件下，自动搜索并优化液冷通道的拓扑形态，使冷却液分布更贴合实际热负荷需求，从而最大化散热效率并降低泵功耗。

该框架的核心创新点在于“物理引导”与“生成式”的结合。传统拓扑优化通常需要大量人工设定初始结构，计算成本高且容易陷入局部最优；而生成式设计能够通过算法自动探索广阔的通道几何空间，产生非直觉但性能优异的流道构型。同时，物理引导机制确保了生成结果在真实热流耦合场景下的可行性，兼顾流动阻力、温度均匀性和结构可制造性。研究进一步探讨了该设计方法在2.5D与3D封装中的差异适应能力，并验证了多芯片协同冷却的可行性。

在性能与对比层面，该研究展示了优化后的液冷通道相比常规设计在温度控制、系统热阻以及冷却液流动功耗方面的显著改善。尽管具体数值需要查阅论文全文，但研究表明，生成式液冷通道能够更精确地将冷却液引导至芯片热点区域，有效降低峰值结温，提升封装的整体可靠性，并可能减少对高成本热界面材料或复杂微通道制造工艺的依赖。

这一技术的影响与应用场景十分广泛。对于AI加速卡、高性能服务器、数据中心和边缘计算设备而言，2.5D/3D封装常被用于集成GPU、CPU、HBM等高功耗器件，液冷通道的智能化设计可直接提升这些系统的散热上限，为下一代算力基础设施提供有力的热管理保障。此外，该框架也可拓展至其他功率电子、激光器、电动汽车逆变器等需要液冷散热的场景，推动生成式设计与热力系统协同优化的工程实践。总体而言，这项研究为先进封装热管理提供了一条从“经验设计”走向“智能生成”的可行路径，有助于释放高密度集成芯片的潜在性能，同时降低冷却系统的能耗与制造成本。

history.content: Just as new data centers face growing backlash from neighboring communities, the US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) is about to make it harder for people to weigh in on any pollution those centers create.The EPA plans to toss out a federal rule requiring public notice and an opportunity to comment when certain industrial sites apply for an air permit. Advocates warn that the move would allow data center developers and other industries to break ground without giving nearby residents a say, or even a warning that construction is planned.“You can see why that would be so interesting to an administration that wants to rush through the construction of data centers,” says Keri Powell, senior attorney and air program leader at the Southern Environmental Law Center (SELC). “What EPA would be allowing would be all of those facilities to go through and just not have to deal with the public, issue the permits in secret behind closed doors. Nobody knows what’s happening until the bulldozers are out there.”“Nobody knows what’s happening until the bulldozers are out there.”The EPA’s proposed changes apply to a permitting process that’s been in place since the 1970s called New Source Review that applies to a wide range of facilities, from landfills and paper mills to power plant expansions. More recently with the rise of generative AI, these permits have also become a flashpoint for opposition to new data centers, as well as to power plants built to provide electricity for all those servers.In July, the EPA announced that it would eliminate the federal public participation requirement for a large set of polluters and place that burden on states. The plan would leave it up to state and local air agencies to decide whether or not to notify the public about certain new sources of pollution — leaving advocates concerned that many of these agencies would forgo the process altogether. Air pollution is often regulated at the federal level because it can waft across the country, affecting residents in one state even if the source is in another.“The state and local authorities closest to the issues and the public should be making the decisions on the permitting process as much as possible, not Washington,” EPA administrator Lee Zeldin said in a statement at the time. “We are cutting unnecessary and burdensome red tape.”The change applies to so-called “minor” sources of pollution, which the EPA says in its announcement “have relatively low emissions and limited environmental impact.” Powell’s group contends that the “minor” label is a misnomer and that the permitting process routinely covers projects that can have significant consequences for their neighbors.Colossus 1, xAI’s massive data center in Tennessee that the company billed as the “most powerful AI training system yet,” applied for a minor source permit in 2025. That led to a hearing and elicited thousands of comments to a public notice posted by the local health department, Inside Climate News reported last year. The SELC and NAACP threatened to sue xAI for installing unpermitted gas turbines at the site the same year.SELC was one of nearly 200 health and environmental groups that filed comments last Friday asking the EPA to withdraw its proposal on New Source Review. They argue that by mandating public comment, residents can provide agencies with valuable insight on the repercussions of building a new data center or other industrial facility.“[The EPA’s proposal] could deprive the agencies making decisions about these [pollution] sources the necessary lived experience data of those communities. Without that information, it is impossible for permitting agencies to evaluate the full, cumulative impact of these facilities,” Kentucky Resources Council Senior Attorney Byron Gary said in a press release.The public comment period for the EPA’s proposal ended last week, and EPA spokesperson Carolyn Holran says in an email to The Verge that they’re still reviewing all the comments submitted — more than 4,900 that need to be addressed before the agency can finalize its rule.

history.titleZh: Trump’s EPA wants to let data centers hide their air pollution
history.descriptionZh:
在美国各地数据中心建设日益引发周边社区强烈反对之际，美国环保署（EPA）却正打算削弱公众对这些项目污染问题的发言权。该机构计划废除一项自1970年代以来实施的联邦规定——即“新源审查”（New Source Review）程序中，要求特定工业设施在申请空气许可时必须进行公开通知并提供公众评议机会。这一变动意味着，数据中心开发商及其他工业项目将能在不通知附近居民、甚至不让他们知晓施工计划的情况下直接破土动工。

“你能理解为什么这对一个急于推进数据中心建设速度的政府来说如此有吸引力，”南方环境法律中心（SELC）高级律师兼空气项目负责人凯里·鲍威尔表示，“环保署的做法是让所有这些设施绕过公众，闭门秘密发放许可。直到推土机开到家门口，没有人知道发生了什么。”

新源审查制度适用于从垃圾填埋场、造纸厂到发电厂扩建等一系列广泛设施。近年来，随着生成式人工智能的爆发式增长，这类许可也成为公众反对新建数据中心及其配套供电电厂的关键焦点。

今年7月，环保署宣布将取消对一大批污染源的联邦公众参与要求，并将这一责任转移给各州。该计划将决定权交由州和地方空气管理机构，由它们自行决定是否就某些新污染源通知公众——倡导者担忧，许多机构可能会完全放弃这一程序。由于空气污染往往具有跨州传播的特性——一个州的污染源可能影响另一个州的居民——联邦层面的监管历来被视为必要的保障。

环保署署长李·泽尔丁当时在声明中表示：“最贴近问题和公众的州和地方机构应尽可能多地决定许可程序，而不是由华盛顿来拍板。我们正在削减不必要的繁琐程序。”

这一变动适用于所谓的“次要”污染源，环保署在公告中称其“排放量相对较低，环境影响有限”。但南方环境法律中心认为，“次要”这一标签具有误导性，许可程序所覆盖的项目常常对周边居民产生重大影响。

以xAI位于田纳西州的巨型数据中心“Colossus 1”为例，该公司称其为“迄今最强大的AI训练系统”。该项目于2025年申请了次要源许可，据《内部气候新闻》报道，该申请引发了听证会，当地卫生部门发布的公告收到了数千条公众意见。同年，南方环境法律中心和全国有色人种协进会（NAACP）威胁起诉xAI，因其在未获许可的情况下安装了燃气轮机。

南方环境法律中心是上周五提交意见、要求环保署撤回新源审查提案的近200个健康与环境组织之一。他们认为，强制公众评议能够让居民为监管机构提供关于新建数据中心或其他工业设施影响的宝贵实地认知。

肯塔基州资源委员会高级律师拜伦·加里在新闻稿中指出：“环保署的提案可能剥夺决策机构获取这些社区真实生活经验数据的机会。没有这些信息，许可机构不可能评估这些设施的完整累积影响。”

环保署提案的公众评议期已于上周结束。该机构发言人卡罗琳·霍兰在给The Verge的邮件中表示，他们仍在审阅收到的超过4900条意见，这些意见需要在规则最终定稿前全部处理完毕。

history.title: MSI brings DDR4 back to gaming laptops amidst DRAM crisis — Katana 15 HX C14 available with up to Core i9-14900HX and RTX 5070
history.description: With 32GB DDR4 SO-DIMM memory kits costing roughly half as much as comparable DDR5 kits, MSI’s new Katana 15 HX C14 could help reduce the impact of soaring memory prices.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 5 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The ongoing DRAM crisis has led to a sharp increase in laptop prices, with manufacturers facing exponentially high component costs, particularly memory and SSDs. The situation has created a growing gap in the affordable gaming laptop segment, with most entry-level models becoming increasingly expensive. In its response, MSI has introduced the new Katana 15 HX C14 that features Intel’s 14th-gen Raptor Lake Refresh processors along with support for both DDR5 and DDR4-3200 memory.Depending on the region, MSI will be offering the value-focused gaming laptop in two variants, featuring dual SO-DIMM slots with either DDR4 or DDR5 compatibility. For context, a 32GB (2x16GB) DDR4-3200 SO-DIMM memory kit can be purchased for around $200, while a DDR5-6000 kit goes for over $400. MSI did not specify the DDR4 capacity as standard, only that the laptop supports up to 96GB, which seems unlikely given no 48GB DDR4 SO-DIMMs exist.Configurable with up to a 24-core Intel Core i9-14900HX processor, the laptop should offer plenty of CPU performance for demanding tasks besides gaming. It will be available with up to an Nvidia RTX 5070 laptop GPU offering support for the latest AI features, GDDR7 memory, DLSS 4.5, and real-time ray tracing. MSI claims that the Katana 15 HX C14 is tuned for up to 170W of combined CPU and GPU power, while the cooling system with dual fans, three heat pipes, and four exhaust outlets helps in sustained performance. There are also dual-PCIe Gen 4x4 M.2 slots, allowing gamers to add a separate SSD dedicated to their gaming library.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Display options include a 15.6-inch IPS panel available with either QHD (2560x1440) resolution that supports up to a 165 Hz refresh rate or FHD (1920x1080) resolution with up to a 144 Hz refresh rate. In terms of design, the laptop comes in a stealthy black finish with textured slash patterns inspired by traditional Japanese blades along with bright red logos. The chassis measures 22.9mm in terms of thickness and weighs 4.62 pounds, making it fairly compact for a 15-inch gaming notebook.Other notable features include support for Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.4, a 4-Zone RGB gaming keyboard with 1.7mm key travel, a 240W power adapter, USB Type-C with Power Delivery 3.0, a 60Whr battery, and DTS-enhanced dual 2W speakers. According to MSI, the new Katana 15 HX C14 will be available globally, although there's no pricing information at the moment.
